name: katex
description: Render mathematical formulas via KaTeX. Foundry built-in: markdown-it outputs [data-math] elements; katex shortcode outputs same format. Resources loaded globally via head/math.html (always-on). Shortcode only outputs HTML marker, not resources.

params.description: Set to 'true' for block/display mode formula (data-math="block")
params.effect: Renders as display (block) formula instead of inline

params.description: Additional CSS class on the span wrapper

css.note: Loaded via head/math.html. Override head/math.html to switch CDN or use local.

js.note: DOM scanner for [data-math] elements. Never modify.
KaTeX library loaded via head/math.html CDN link.

assets.size_impact: ~1KB local (katex-render.js) + ~120KB CDN (deferred, cached). CDN loaded on ALL pages.
assets.cdn_note: Override head/math.html to switch CDN version or use local static/caps/katex/ files

locked.reason: data-math attribute is the contract between markdown-it output and katex-render.js. Changing it breaks rendering.

css_in_main.note: KaTeX renders its own classes. Add wrapper styles to main.css if needed.

partials.note: Override to: (1) disable KaTeX entirely (empty file), (2) switch CDN URL, (3) use local files
Override to empty file to disable katex-render.js injection
Override to change the span wrapper output format (keep data-math attribute)
